idea-plugin.name: TU Code
idea-plugin.description:
TU Code turns your JetBrains IDE into a multi-agent control room: isolated git worktrees for parallel tasks, native remote-development support, GitHub-aware diffs, and hundreds of models, all in one IDE frame.

  • Remote-dev native. 100% native Swing UI, no embedded browser and no Node.js, so it works identically locally and in JetBrains Remote Development split mode.
  • Agent Manager. Run several agent sessions at once, each isolated in its own git worktree, without a new IDE window per task.
  • Run and debug per worktree. Your existing Run Configurations work on any worktree; escalate one to a full IDE frame in a click when you need breakpoints.
  • GitHub built in. Per-worktree PR status, diff versus base branch, uncommitted changes, and one-click import from a PR URL.
  • Model freedom. Hundreds of models across all major providers with your own API keys or your organization's gateway, per-agent model pinning, and organization access controls.
  • One runtime everywhere. Built on the TU Code CLI, the same engine as the TU Code VS Code extension, sharing one config, agents, skills, and MCP servers.
